value: Goal-1 benches spend fights on unseen mechanics (an enemy of familiar parts has no burst-recoverable cost); a boss burst is no goal-2 candidate. Reopen on boss-state inputs (move schedule, HP-scaled attacks, Burn rows) or a boss burst beating other-content bursts by >=0.05 one turn deep.

sources.anchor: After unseen-boss-burst: games do not buy play on a whole unseen boss; lane sequential-bursts opened (on the owner's behalf, 2026-11-05)
